prompt: Create a highly detailed, polished science-museum infographic poster in portrait format explaining prismatic glass and light refraction. Translucent glassmorphism, glossy cut crystal, iridescent spectral dispersion, dark midnight navy technical background with subtle grid, luminous cyan/violet/magenta/amber accents, crisp editorial hierarchy, intricately drawn ray paths and miniature diagrams, realistic caustics and reflections, precise geometric composition, generous spacing, clean readable visual organization. Central large transparent triangular prism receiving a narrow white beam and splitting it into a vivid rainbow. Surround it with carefully arranged small ray-angle and internal-reflection diagrams, wavelength waveforms, glassy outlined panels, thin connector lines, ticks and labels. Only render the exact copy explicitly provided by text boxes; no extra writing. Keep infographic extremely detailed yet uncluttered.
negativePrompt: blurry text, misspellings, invented text, extra lettering, clutter, opaque plastic, low detail, distorted geometry, inaccurate prism, watermark, logo, low contrast, noisy background
